# Pruv — Measured Skincare Reviews

> Turn your skincare product trials into measured reviews backed by before/after YouCam AI Skin Analysis.

Pruv is not a generic skin scanner, AI dermatologist, or clinical diagnosis tool. It is a new review format for skincare products: a real human product trial backed by before-and-after skin measurements.

- **Website**: https://pruv.vercel.app
- **Repository**: https://github.com/nikhil/pruv
- **API Engine**: Perfect Corp. YouCam AI Skin Analysis v2.1
- **Database**: Supabase Postgres
- **License**: MIT

---

## 🎯 Core Loop & Review Format

Normal skincare reviews:
```
★★★★★
"Worked great for me!"
```

Pruv Proof Review:
```
★★★★☆ (4.5 / 5)
21-day trial
Would buy again: Yes

Redness score      +8.6
Radiance score     +5.3
Texture score      +0.7
Acne score         -2.5
Pores score        -1.1

"Skin felt calmer and less red by the end of week two."

Measured with Perfect Corp. YouCam Skin AI v2.1
```

---

## 🛠️ Architecture & Tech Stack

- **Framework**: Next.js 15 (App Router, React Server Components, TypeScript)
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS & custom design tokens (Warm minimalist editorial palette `#FAF8F5`, `#18181B`, `#5B4FE8`)
- **Skin AI**: Perfect Corp. YouCam AI Skin Analysis v2.1 (S2S Task & Polling API)
  - `hd_redness`: Facial redness & erythema detection
  - `hd_radiance`: Skin luminosity & radiance
  - `hd_texture`: Skin surface smoothness & roughness
  - `hd_acne`: Active acne, papules & pustules
  - `hd_pore`: Enlarged pore visibility across facial regions
- **Database**: Supabase (PostgreSQL with Row Level Security & Participant UUID Tokens)
- **AI Synthesis**: OpenRouter DeepSeek V3 for observational review summaries

---

## 🛣️ Application Routes

- `/`: Landing page explaining the 3-step proof concept and demo links
- `/start`: Instant participant onboarding (product name, brand, trial duration)
- `/demo`: Dual-bento interactive sandbox (view complete Proof Review or test live scan)
- `/p/[slug]/scan?type=baseline`: Day 1 live camera capture or raw photo upload
- `/p/[slug]/baseline`: Day 1 baseline results card showing 5 measured metrics
- `/p/[slug]/my-proof`: Live trial countdown dashboard & reminder settings
- `/p/[slug]/scan?type=followup`: Day 21 follow-up scan in identical lighting
- `/p/[slug]/compare`: Side-by-side photo comparison & metric delta table
- `/p/[slug]/review`: 3-step user experience form (stars, would-buy-again, quote)
- `/p/[slug]/proof`: Verified Proof Review receipt with public ProofLink generator
- `/proof/[slug]`: Public, shareable Proof Review receipt page

---

## 🔌 API Endpoints

- `POST /api/participant/start`: Create a new participant trial session
- `POST /api/youcam/upload-slot`: Request presigned S3 upload URL from YouCam API
- `POST /api/scans/start`: Initialize a YouCam Skin Analysis v2.1 task
- `GET /api/scans/[scanId]/status`: Poll YouCam task completion & save normalized scores
- `POST /api/reviews`: Save participant qualitative experience & ratings
- `POST /api/reviews/publish`: Generate shareable public slug for the Proof Review
- `GET /api/proof-receipts`: Fetch structured receipt data and scan photos

---

## 📖 Key Principles

1. **Observational, Not Diagnostic**: Pruv clearly states that results are observational measurements of skin surface appearance, not clinical medical diagnoses.
2. **Deterministic Deltas**: Changes between Day 1 and Day 21 are calculated as direct mathematical deltas (`Followup Score - Baseline Score`).
3. **No Fake Reviews**: Every Proof Review is strictly tied to real YouCam API vision analysis on actual captured photos.
